title: Could AI help bring D-Day: Frontier Commander back to modern Android?
author: Who_knows_who_els
selftext:
Hey everyone!

I wanted to ask if anyone here with Android development experience, game preservation knowledge, or AI-assisted programming skills would be interested in bringing back **D-Day: Frontier Commander** so that it can run properly on modern Android devices.

I would absolutely love to play this game again, and I imagine there are other people who still remember it and would enjoy playing it today. Unfortunately, getting older Android games running can be incredibly difficult, especially when the original game is no longer easily available or compatible with current versions of Android.

Trying to find a working version through random tutorials, unofficial APK websites, and emulator downloads can be risky and frustrating. There is always the concern of malware, suspicious software, fake copies, or modified installers that you simply cannot trust.

**Would it be possible to use modern AI tools to help rebuild, restore, or port the game to current Android versions?** Ideally, the result would be a clean, safe, native Android experience that people could install and play without needing questionable emulators, suspicious APKs, or complicated workarounds.

I understand that this might be a challenging project, especially if the original source code is unavailable. I am not suggesting that AI could magically recreate everything with one click. However, perhaps experienced developers could use AI to assist with reverse engineering, compatibility fixes, recreating gameplay systems, or developing a new version inspired by the original, while respecting the game's intellectual property.

My goal is simple: **give people a safe way to experience D-Day: Frontier Commander again on modern Android devices.**

If you have experience with Android game development, game preservation, APK analysis, Unity, reverse engineering, or AI-assisted coding, I would love to hear your thoughts.

* Is a project like this technically possible?
* Are there any developers who might be interested in helping?
* Does anyone know whether the original source code or legitimate game assets are still available?
* Would anyone else love to see this game return?

Even advice, technical suggestions, or finding other people interested in preserving this game would be greatly appreciated.

Thanks for reading, and hopefully we can find a way to bring this game back! ❤️
